a.description: N-dimensional array of bits to pack.
constraints: input `a` must be an N-dimensional array of bits

axis.description: optional axis along which to pack bits. If not specified, ``a`` will be flattened.
constraints: axis must satisfy -rank(input) <= axis < rank(input) if specified

bitorder.description: ``"big"`` (default) or ``"little"``: specify whether the bit order is big-endian or little-endian.

output.description: A uint8 array of packed values.
